Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals threatening damage and can knock you up, so watch its windup and dodge outside the blade’s tip range or inside it. If the knock-up is difficult to dodge, block it with Fiora W Riposte and try to stun him. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave the area immediately. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, create distance and fight again after it expires.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and W Infernal Chains. If Aatrox’s sustained healing restores the health you take from him during trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items. Since Aatrox has high armor, add penetration and make use of the vital damage from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance, which isn’t blocked by armor.
Aatrox.fight: Trade briefly right after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. If you hit a vital, use the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance to back away and avoid his counterattack. Bait out Aatrox E Umbral Dash, then look for a chance to close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge.
Aatrox.laning: Don’t force a lane win against Aatrox’s strong early physical damage. Stay within experience range, even if you have to give up some minions, and let the wave push toward your turret so you can farm without giving up a kill. Chip away at his health with short vital trades, but avoid extended fights because of his healing.
Aatrox.combo: If a vital appears on Aatrox’s side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge in that direction to hit it, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If the vital is in front, hit it first with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. Activate Fiora E Bladework when you can stay close, and look for an angle to land its second empowered attack on a new vital.
Aatrox.escape: The moment after you bait out Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your chance to go in with Fiora Q Lunge. If you can block the knock-up from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade with Fiora W Riposte, stun him and keep fighting. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, prioritize leaving its area over engaging, and save Fiora Q Lunge so you can use it to get out.
Aatrox.phase: Aatrox can become strong quickly if he gets ahead early, so focus on gaining experience and CS without giving up a kill. In the late game, keep up side lane pressure with the items you've accumulated and avoid large teamfights when possible.
Aatrox.teamfight: If you have to take a teamfight, you can target a healing frontline like Aatrox with Fiora R Grand Challenge. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target heals nearby allies and creates a chance to turn the fight around.

Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it hits and marks you, the second dash follows even if you try to escape. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking. Its second hit gets stronger based on your missing health, so save Fiora W Riposte if you expect her to engage.
Akali.build: Build magic resistance first against Akali’s main damage. Get health to withstand the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution, and movement speed to help you get out of announced attack ranges.
Akali.fight: When Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to trade, hit a vital, take a short trade, then back away using the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance. After forcing her to use her mobility abilities, close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge and stick to her with the slow from Fiora W Riposte.
Akali.laning: After hitting one vital, don’t overchase; back off and build a health and CS lead while Akali R Perfect Execution is unavailable.
Akali.combo: If a vital appears on Akali’s side or behind her, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, land a basic attack, then activate Fiora E Bladework. Slow her with E’s first empowered attack, then hit the vital with the second empowered critical attack. If the vital appears in front, hit it first with a basic attack and E, and save Q to chase or disengage.
Akali.escape: Dodge the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip, then engage when Akali W Twilight Shroud and R Perfect Execution are both unavailable. Don’t rush in if she has only used one mobility ability, since she can escape with the other. When you go in with Fiora Q Lunge, hit your target to reduce its cooldown; when you back off, use the movement speed from hitting a vital.
Akali.phase: Look to play aggressively while Akali R Perfect Execution is unavailable.
Akali.teamfight: If you have to take a teamfight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can heal nearby allies.

Aurora.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, Q Twofold Hex, and E The Weirding. If the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration makes up for your damage between trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Aurora.fight: Use short trades to hit a vital and force Aurora to use her mobility first. Once Aurora E The Weirding and W Across the Veil are unavailable, close the gap again with Fiora Q Lunge and keep hitting vitals. Don’t let the fight drag on at low health while waiting for Aurora Q Twofold Hex to be recalled.
Aurora.laning: Early on, don’t overextend. Hit one vital, then create distance with the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance. If a vital appears in a hard-to-reach direction, don’t force your way in; wait for the next one. If a short trade makes Aurora use E The Weirding or W Across the Veil, look for an angle for your next engage.
Aurora.combo: If a vital appears on Aurora’s side or behind her, use Fiora Q Lunge in that direction, then a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework for a short trade. If the vital is in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. Activate Fiora E Bladework when you can stay close, and look for an angle to land its second empowered attack on a new vital.
Aurora.escape: Close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge when Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are both unavailable. Use Fiora W Riposte to block and counter her key attacks.
Aurora.teamfight: If you have to take a teamfight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to seek vital damage and healing. If Aurora leaps in and fails to kill anyone, look for a chance to catch her then.
Aurora.phase: In the early game, Fiora avoids overcommitting and repeats short trades. The available information isn't enough to determine which champion is stronger in each stage of the game.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when it is recast, and the recast damage increases as Fiora's health gets lower. If you are cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself. If your health is borderline, back off before the recast. After Aurora R Between Worlds is cast, you are slowed when leaving the zone, so get out before it appears or look for an opening to fight inside it.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from a long distance and stun you, so stand away from walls. When Camille Q Precision Protocol’s empowered attack is threatening, create distance or nullify it with Fiora W Riposte. Don’t use a counter ability at the moment Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages; if you’re trapped, endure the zone’s duration, then counterattack.
Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage. Armor can’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your max health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield. Once the shield has been stripped away, hit a vital and take a short trade. Use the movement speed from the vital to back away before Camille Q Precision Protocol’s empowered attack can reach you.
Camille.laning: Stand away from walls and among your minions so Camille E Hookshot can’t push you toward a wall. Camille clears waves slowly before her first core item, so take lane control and pressure her farming when you can. If a trade would go badly, give up some minions if needed to stay in experience range and let the wave push toward your turret.
Camille.combo: If a vital appears on Camille’s side or behind her, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If the vital is in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. When Camille E Hookshot’s stun is about to land, block it with Fiora W Riposte and try to stun her in return.
Camille.escape: Close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge after Camille E Hookshot and R The Hextech Ultimatum are both unavailable. Look especially for an opening before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is back up; if only Camille E Hookshot is unavailable, stay mindful of her remaining ultimate.
Camille.phase: Camille is weak early before her first core item, so slow her growth with trades and farming pressure whenever possible. From the mid game onward, Camille takes down turrets quickly, so don’t leave a side lane unattended.
Camille.teamfight: Prioritize side lane pressure and small skirmishes over large teamfights. If you have to take a teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to deal true damage based on max health. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.

Chogath.watch: Dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture to the side when you see the ground telegraph, using Fiora Q Lunge if needed. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, you cannot escape with Fiora Q Lunge, so avoid standing directly in front of him and walk away while silenced. If your health is at half or below, retreat out of range of Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.
Chogath.build: If Cho'Gath's P Carnivore healing lets him withstand trades, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about choices that add a lot of health alone.
Chogath.combo: If a vital appears on the side or behind him, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If the vital appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or escape. After dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture or blocking it with Fiora W Riposte, activate Fiora E Bladework when you can get close and use both empowered attacks.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility spell, so go in with Fiora Q Lunge when Cho'Gath Q Rupture has been used on the wave or his crowd control is down. Blocking Cho'Gath Q Rupture with Fiora W Riposte can stun him, creating an opening to engage. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you after you go in, walk away before trying to use a spell.
Chogath.phase: Early on, Fiora should pressure Cho'Gath to slow his stacking. Cho'Gath becomes harder to fight as he stacks in the late game, so don't let him secure a kill with Cho'Gath R Feast when you're unsure whether your health is safe.
Chogath.fight: Avoid Cho'Gath W Feral Scream's frontal area, hit a vital from the side, then back off with the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance after a short trade. If Cho'Gath Q Rupture is used on the wave or his crowd control is down, close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge.
Chogath.laning: Push or pressure the lane early to limit Cho'Gath's chances to stack. Don't stand in the line of Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes behind the minions, and save Fiora Q Lunge to dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture. You can look for a jungle gank right after Cho'Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave.
Chogath.teamfight: If you have to take a teamfight, you can target Cho'Gath with Fiora R Grand Challenge to break through the frontline with max-health-based true damage. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target also heals nearby allies.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you're likely to get hit by follow-up attacks, so poke from outside its range and use Fiora W Riposte as he pulls you. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move out of the blade's range or stay close to reduce his healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance; if your health is low while they are stacked, retreat completely out of Darius R Noxian Guillotine range.
Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius's physical damage, but also get health to account for the penetration on Darius E Apprehend and the true damage from R Noxian Guillotine. If healing from Darius Q Decimate negates your trades, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Against a Darius with high armor, add penetration and make use of the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and R Grand Challenge.
Darius.fight: After Darius E Apprehend misses or is down, hit one vital and use the movement speed you gain to back off, repeating these short trades. Right after Darius Q Decimate is used to clear minions is another chance to poke. Cut off extended fights as Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, then look for another opening once the stacks disappear.
Darius.combo: If a vital appears on the side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to move toward that direction and hit it, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If the vital is in front, hit it first with a basic attack and E, saving Q to chase or escape. Save Fiora W Riposte for Darius E Apprehend, and use E's second empowered basic attack if you can land it on a new vital.
Darius.escape: Go in during the window when Darius E Apprehend misses, using Fiora Q Lunge in a direction that can hit the enemy. You can engage after Darius R Noxian Guillotine is down, but if Darius P Hemorrhage stacks have built up, create distance first to end the fight. Save Fiora W Riposte when you need to block Darius E Apprehend.
Darius.phase: Early on, reduce losses by avoiding Darius's powerful physical damage trades and chaotic brawls.
Darius.teamfight: Pressure side lanes when possible. If you have to join a teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline and target the vitals. R's vitals deal true damage based on maximum health, and hitting all four or killing the target also heals nearby allies. Back off if you are low on health with Darius P Hemorrhage stacks, so he can't secure a kill with Darius R Noxian Guillotine and reset its cooldown.
Darius.laning: Early on, don't force a lane win. Let some minions go if needed, and keep the wave pulled toward your turret while staying in experience range. Stay outside Darius E Apprehend range and take short trades only when E is down. Once you have items in the mid game, force 1v1s in the side lane.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target it encounters and deals damage based on current health, so keep minions between you and him, especially when your health is high. You can block a hard-to-dodge Q with Fiora W Riposte, but don't expect a stun since Dr. Mundo is not shown to have a crowd control effect that immobilizes you. When Dr. Mundo activates R Maximum Dosage, his healing and movement speed increase, so don't spend time trying to kill him.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Also keep in mind that armor can't block the magic damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and W Heart Zapper. If Dr. Mundo's healing makes duels drag on even after you've built resistances, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
DrMundo.fight: Look for a vital and take a short trade from a position where minions can block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. If a vital appears on the side or behind him, go in with Fiora Q Lunge and hit it; if it appears in front, save Q and hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. Back off after hitting the vital, using the movement speed you gain, and look for an extended duel while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down.
DrMundo.laning: Early on, repeat short trades that pop one vital instead of forcing extended fights. Stand among minions to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and step on the canister he drops as you back off after a trade to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction. If a vital appears in a direction you can't hit, don't force your way in; wait for the next vital.
DrMundo.combo: If a vital appears on the side or behind him, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. Slow Dr. Mundo with E's first empowered basic attack, and if you can stay close, land its second guaranteed critical strike basic attack on a new vital. Use Fiora W Riposte to block Dr. Mundo's attacks or when you need a slow, but don't expect W to stun him while Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability that creates distance, so dodge or block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, then close the distance with Fiora Q Lunge. His abilities are not shown to have an immobilizing effect, so there is no confirmed window to aim for a stun with Fiora W Riposte. After going in, trade and disengage using the movement speed from vitals and the slow from Fiora E Bladework.
DrMundo.phase: The available information does not establish who has the early advantage, so focus on short trades. Don't commit to a kill while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available; pressure him when it's down.
DrMundo.teamfight: Prioritize side lane pressure and small skirmishes over large teamfights. If you have to join a teamfight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on Dr. Mundo in the frontline. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target also heals nearby allies, so look for an angle to hit the vitals in succession.

Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack silences you and prevents you from retaliating, so don't approach while it's active. Once Garen E Judgment starts spinning, staying close will cost you, so move out of its range. If your health falls below half, watch out for Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on missing health, and don't remain within range.
Garen.fight: Take a short trade immediately after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack has been spent. Pop a vital with Fiora P Duelist's Dance to gain healing and movement speed, then back off before taking prolonged spinning damage from Garen E Judgment. Don't unload your attacks at the moment Garen W Courage grants its shield and tenacity; delay slightly.
Garen.combo: If a vital appears behind or beside Garen, use Fiora Q Lunge in that direction, then a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework for a short trade. If the vital appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or escape. Don't unload your combo right after Garen activates W Courage; wait out the shield and tenacity.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility spell, so the moment after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack is used on a minion or runs out is a chance to go in with Fiora Q Lunge. If he engages with the empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike, you can block it with Fiora W Riposte and counterattack. After the trade, use the movement speed from popping a vital to get out of the spinning area of Garen E Judgment.
Garen.phase: Early on, pressure Garen to slow the stacking from Garen W Courage, but minimize losses and play it out if physical damage trades are unfavorable.
Garen.build: Build armor first to deal with the main damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. If healing from Garen P Perseverance makes up for the health you take off by proccing vitals, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Armor doesn't reduce the true damage from Garen R Demacian Justice, so consider health as well.
Garen.laning: You fall behind as Garen W Courage's growth stacks build, so pressure him early and deny him time to stack. If trading through the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment is too difficult, give up some minions if needed, stay within experience range, and let the wave come toward your turret. Garen has no mobility, so when you can push safely, push the wave past him and create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
Garen.teamfight: Fiora prioritizes side lane pressure over large teamfights. If you have to take a teamfight, you can also use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the frontline to deal max-health-based true damage. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can heal nearby allies as well.

Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg gets more dangerous as it ages, so distinguish newly placed kegs from older ones. Break a nearby keg from outside its blast radius, and avoid standing where two kegs overlap.
Gangplank.build: Build armor first in lane to withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley poke and the physical damage from E Powder Keg. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy’s healing extends the duel, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items. Also consider your total health, since resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire and R Cannon Barrage.
Gangplank.fight: When Gangplank has just placed E Powder Keg, close in with Fiora Q Lunge for a short trade. Back off if there’s an aged keg nearby. If you proc Fiora P Duelist’s Dance, use the movement speed to create distance. Watch whether Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is available, since it can cleanse the slow from Fiora W Riposte.
Gangplank.laning: Early on, watch for Gangplank Q Parrrley poke to wear you down, and don’t force winning unfavorable physical damage trades. If needed, give up a few minions to stay in experience range and let the wave come toward your turret. Trade only during the brief window before Gangplank E Powder Keg ages to limit early losses.
Gangplank.combo: If a vital appears on Gangplank’s side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to move toward that direction and strike it, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If it appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or retreat. When you can stay close, activate Fiora E Bladework: slow him with the first empowered attack, then hit the vital with the second.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Fiora Q Lunge after he has just placed E Powder Keg or after you break a nearby keg. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is on cooldown, take advantage of the window when he cannot cleanse the slow from Fiora E Bladework or W Riposte. Delay your engage if Gangplank E Powder Keg is aged.
Gangplank.phase: Early on, watch for Gangplank Q Parrrley poke and E Powder Keg, and focus on limiting Fiora’s losses.
Gangplank.teamfight: Fiora gains more from side lane pressure than from large teamfights. If you have to teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline and target its vitals. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.

Gnar.watch: Mini Gnar’s Q Boomerang Throw can hit both on the way out and on the way back, so move out of its path. Mega Gnar R GNAR! stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. If you can read the cast, block it with Fiora W Riposte.
Gnar.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, E Hop / Crunch, and R GNAR!. Armor does not block the magic damage from Gnar W Hyper / Wallop, which scales with your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Gnar.fight: When Mini Gnar pokes from range, don’t chase vitals recklessly; take short trades. Bait out Gnar E Hop / Crunch, then close in with Fiora Q Lunge. Use the movement speed from hitting a vital to go for the next one or retreat.
Gnar.laning: Early on, don’t overcommit to beating Gnar’s poke. Give up a few minions if needed to stay in experience range, and let the wave come toward your turret. Avoid direct fights right after Gnar transforms into Mega form, and look to trade just after he returns to Mini form, while he cannot transform again.
Gnar.combo: If a vital is on Gnar’s side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to move toward that direction and strike it, then follow with a basic attack and E Bladework. If it appears in front, hit it first with a basic attack and E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or retreat. Slow him with the first empowered attack from E Bladework, then hit the vital with the second.
Gnar.escape: The moment after Gnar uses E Hop / Crunch is a window to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. Don’t engage first if Mega Gnar R GNAR! could knock you into a wall; use Fiora W Riposte when you can read the cast.
Gnar.phase: Early on, Mini Gnar pokes from range, so Fiora should limit losses and focus on scaling. Once she has some items in the mid game, Fiora can force 1v1s in the side lane. Continue seeking an advantage through side lane pressure rather than large teamfights in the late game.
Gnar.teamfight: Don't stand with your back to a wall, and be wary of fights in narrow areas so Gnar R GNAR! can't knock you into a wall. If possible, Fiora should pressure the side lane. If you have to take a teamfight, use R Grand Challenge to hit vitals on the enemy frontline and seek damage and healing.

Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so last-hit from outside its range and focus on dodging when she casts it. Illaoi R Leap of Faith is her peak damage window; when she activates it, create distance and wait out its duration.
Illaoi.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Q Tentacle Smash, and W Harsh Lesson. Fit Executioner’s Calling between core items to counter her sustained healing. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Illaoi.fight: Bait out Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, then close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge. Hit one vital, then use the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance to disengage from a short trade. If Illaoi E Test of Spirit pulls your soul, fight back if the situation allows.
Illaoi.laning: Early on, don’t force winning heavy physical damage trades. Give up a few minions if needed, but stay in experience range and let the wave come toward your turret. Stay away from walls and tentacles, and last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit range.
Illaoi.combo: If a vital appears on Illaoi’s side or behind her, use Fiora Q Lunge to move toward that direction and hit it, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If it appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or retreat. If you read one of Illaoi’s key attacks, block it with Fiora W Riposte.
Illaoi.escape: The moment after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson is a chance to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. If you also dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, trade briefly while the risk of being caught is lower. Use the movement speed from hitting a vital to retreat.
Illaoi.phase: Early on, avoid heavy physical damage trades with Illaoi and focus on limiting losses. Once Fiora has some items in the mid game, she forces 1v1s in the side lane.
Illaoi.teamfight: Destroy Illaoi’s tentacles when you can; otherwise, draw her away from the walls. Don’t group up against Illaoi R Leap of Faith; spread out and wait out its duration. Fiora should prioritize side lane pressure over large teamfights. If you have to teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to target its vitals for damage and healing.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the gap, so create distance when minions are about to die. Save Fiora W Riposte to block and counter Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun. If you’re caught inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.
Irelia.build: If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge lets her withstand trades, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. The data does not specify the first item to buy or which type of resistance to build.
Irelia.fight: The moment after Irelia Q Bladesurge is used is a chance to close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge. After hitting a vital, use the movement speed to disengage quickly. Use Fiora W Riposte against the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a half-health minion between you and Irelia that she can use to dash in with Q Bladesurge.
Irelia.combo: If a vital appears on the side or behind, use Fiora Q Lunge to hit it, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If it appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or retreat. When Irelia casts E Flawless Duet, use Fiora W Riposte to block the stun.
Irelia.escape: The moment after you force Irelia to use Q Bladesurge is a window to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. Engage when Irelia E Flawless Duet is on cooldown or when you can block it with Fiora W Riposte. After hitting a vital, use the movement speed to retreat.
Irelia.phase: The data does not specify who has the advantage in the mid game.
Irelia.teamfight: If possible, avoid large teamfights and pressure the side lane. If you have to teamfight, prioritize Irelia before she can influence the fight with R Vanguard’s Edge and E Flawless Duet. Depending on the situation, you can also use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to hit vitals and heal your allies.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen’s main damage, and consider Spectre’s Cowl. If healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts restores her health between trades, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items. Gwen has high armor, so add penetration or use Fiora P Duelist’s Dance’s true damage.
Gwen.fight: Take short trades before Gwen stacks Q Snip Snip! or right after she uses E Skip 'n Slash. After hitting a Fiora P Duelist’s Dance vital, use the movement speed to retreat and reduce her counterattack. When it’s hard to dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, Fiora W Riposte can block the attack.
Gwen.laning: Trade before she builds stacks. After popping one vital, use the movement speed to disengage instead of chasing deep. If you bait out Gwen E Skip 'n Slash first, Fiora Q Lunge gives you a chance to close the gap again.
Gwen.combo: If a vital appears on Gwen’s side or behind her, use Fiora Q Lunge to reach it, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If it appears in front, hit it first with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. If you can hit a new vital with Fiora E Bladework’s second empowered attack, pop it too.
Gwen.escape: Right after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is used is your window to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. Gwen can hit minions to reduce E Skip 'n Slash’s cooldown, so engage where there are fewer minions if possible. This guide lists no immobilizing crowd control for Gwen, so don’t engage assuming Fiora W Riposte will stun her.
Gwen.phase: Early on, look to trade before Gwen stacks Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.teamfight: Avoid large teamfights if possible and apply pressure in a side lane. If you have to teamfight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on even a highly armored frontline target. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can heal nearby allies too.
Gwen.watch: Move sideways to dodge the center of the cone from Gwen Q Snip Snip!, which deals true damage. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can target her from outside the mist, so wait until it ends unless you have an opening to go in. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash has its cooldown greatly reduced when it hits something, so be careful about chasing her where there are lots of minions.

Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, stop basic attacking and move out of stun range. If you can’t avoid the recast stun, block it with Fiora W Riposte and return the stun. Jax can close in with Q Leap Strike, so don’t use Fiora Q Lunge first without a plan.
Jax.build: Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed are the core of his damage, so consider ways to reduce his attack speed first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Jax.fight: Look to trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. Hit a vital briefly, then retreat using Fiora P Duelist’s Dance’s movement speed. If Jax Q Leap Strike is also down, close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge and go for the next vital.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee trade, so don’t force yourself into melee range.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, if the vital is on his side or behind him, attack with Fiora Q Lunge → basic attack → Fiora E Bladework. If the vital is in front, save Fiora Q Lunge and hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If you have to take the recast stun from Jax E Counter Strike, time Fiora W Riposte for that moment.
Jax.escape: Conversely, after Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike are down, you have a chance to engage with Fiora Q Lunge.
Jax.teamfight: Don’t group near Jax and let multiple people get hit by the area stun from Jax E Counter Strike. If Jax comes in with Counter Strike active, let its duration run out and, if needed, use Fiora W Riposte to counter the stun. You can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to deal maximum-health-based true damage and heal.

Jayce.watch: When Jayce is holding his cannon and places Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast may follow, so sidestep out of the line of fire. When he holds his hammer, watch for the leap and knockback; use Fiora W Riposte to block the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate.
Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first, accounting for the magic damage from Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance won’t block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and E deals damage based on your maximum health, so also get movement speed to leave the marked area instead of stacking health alone.
Jayce.fight: Look for short trades where you dodge Jayce’s ranged poke and hit a vital. Right after you make Jayce use Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge and time Fiora W Riposte for the knockback.
Jayce.laning: Jayce is strong early, so move side to side to dodge his cannon’s linear attacks and farm defensively. After hitting one vital, use the movement speed to retreat and keep the trade short; when health has been chipped away, don’t force yourself to stay in lane.
Jayce.combo: If a vital appears on Jayce’s side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to reach it, hit it, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If it appears in front, hit it first with a basic attack and E, saving Q to chase or disengage. Activate E while close enough to hit a new vital with its second empowered attack.
Jayce.escape: Right after you make Jayce use the leap from Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is your window to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. If hammer-form Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate is still available, time Fiora W Riposte for the knockback; if that ability is also down, get close and go for the next vital.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so if you fall behind, farm and buy time instead of forcing a comeback.
Jayce.teamfight: If you have to teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to hit its vitals. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target also heals nearby allies.

KSante.watch: If you’ve been hit by K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes in succession or K'Sante has stacked it by hitting minions, watch for the next pull and stun by moving out of range or saving Fiora Q Lunge. K'Sante W Path Maker is unstoppable and grants damage reduction while charging, so don’t commit your damage; sidestep the direction of the dash. Don’t fight with your back to a wall where K'Sante R All Out can knock you through it.
KSante.build: For offense, consider penetration first against K'Sante’s high armor, and make active use of the true-damage vitals from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge. For defense, build armor against K'Sante’s physical damage, and consider health if you need to withstand the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker. Magic resistance has no value against this opponent, and you can prioritize tenacity if K'Sante’s crowd control is the problem.
KSante.fight: If a vital appears on his side or behind him, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge; if it appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Q to chase or disengage. After popping one vital, use the movement speed to briefly retreat and avoid his counterattack. K'Sante R All Out lowers his armor, creating an opening to attack, but it also increases his damage and life steal, so don’t stay in the fight too long.
KSante.laning: If K'Sante’s physical damage trades become too difficult later, keep within experience range even if you have to give up some minions, and let the lane push toward your turret.
KSante.combo: If you have an angle on a side or rear vital, take a short trade with Fiora Q Lunge → basic attack → Fiora E Bladework. Use E’s slow to stay close and hit the vital with the second empowered attack, then use the movement speed from popping it to reach the next vital. If K'Sante still has a mobility ability and can immediately escape, delay using E so you don’t waste both attacks.
KSante.escape: Don’t go deep just because K'Sante W Path Maker is down; check whether K'Sante E Footwork and K'Sante R All Out are still available too. Look to close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge when the other mobility ability is also down, especially before K'Sante R All Out comes back up. If K'Sante answers with crowd control, blocking it with Fiora W Riposte can stun him in return.
KSante.phase: Even late game, Fiora is stronger applying side lane pressure than in large teamfights.
KSante.teamfight: Avoid large teamfights if possible, apply pressure in a side lane, and use Fiora R Grand Challenge’s vitals in small skirmishes. If you have to teamfight, you can cast R on K'Sante in the highly armored frontline to deal maximum-health-based true damage. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal allies, and it’s best for at least one person on your team to have Grievous Wounds against the life steal from K'Sante R All Out.

Kennen.watch: Kennen P Mark of the Storm stuns after three stacks, so back off after being hit twice and wait for the stacks to expire. Dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and time Fiora W Riposte to block the stun when Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom is about to stun you.
Kennen.build: Build magic resistance before armor to prepare for Kennen’s damage. Movement speed is also useful for escaping Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom’s area.
Kennen.fight: Trade briefly by hitting a vital, then back off with the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance. Once Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, close in with Fiora Q Lunge and fight.
Kennen.laning: Stand behind minions to block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and step forward briefly only to last-hit. If the vital appears in a hard-to-hit direction, don’t force it; wait for the next one.
Kennen.combo: If the vital appears to the side or behind Kennen and Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, attack in this order: Fiora Q Lunge → basic attack → Fiora E Bladework. Slow him with the first empowered basic attack from Fiora E Bladework, then hit the vital with the second. If the vital is in front, hit it with a basic attack first and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase.
Kennen.escape: Once Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, look for a chance to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has two stacks, back off first to let them expire, then save Fiora W Riposte to block the stun when you go back in.
Kennen.phase: Early on, avoid Kennen’s poke, take short trades, and don’t overcommit.
Kennen.teamfight: If possible, pressure the side lane instead of joining a large team fight. If you have to fight, spread out so your allies aren’t hit together by Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, and look for a moment to block the stun with Fiora W Riposte. You can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to hit vitals and heal your allies.

Kayle.fight: If Kayle uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing to create distance, follow with Fiora Q Lunge and activate Fiora E Bladework when you can stay close. During the invulnerability from Kayle R Divine Judgment, keep her in range with the slow from Fiora W Riposte, then attack again when it ends.
Kayle.laning: If the vital appears in a direction you can’t reach, don’t force your way in; wait for the next one.
Kayle.combo: If the vital appears to Kayle’s side or behind her, use Fiora Q Lunge to close in and hit it, then follow up with Fiora E Bladework after a basic attack. If it appears in front, handle it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. Position yourself so the second empowered basic attack from Fiora E Bladework can hit a new vital.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility abilities, so if she uses the movement speed boost from Kayle W Celestial Blessing and you’re still in range afterward, engage with Fiora Q Lunge. Right after dodging Kayle Q Radiant Blast, you have a chance to close in without being slowed or having your resistances reduced.
Kayle.phase: Use an early lead to take towers and objectives. If the game drags on, look for fights with a numbers advantage on the side of the map where Kayle isn’t.
Kayle.teamfight: Fiora is better off gaining an advantage through side-lane pressure than large team fights. If you have to join a fight, find a path to Kayle from the flank or out of vision, and engage when your allies apply crowd control. It’s a good time to fight if Kayle R Divine Judgment has already been used. When you have to fight the frontline, use the maximum-health-based true damage and healing from Fiora R Grand Challenge.
Kayle.build: If healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing makes up for the damage between trades, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Kayle's damage, but prioritize dodging Kayle Q Radiant Blast because it reduces resistances.
Kayle.watch: Avoid being hit directly by Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces armor and magic resistance. When your health is low, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade, which becomes stronger based on missing health. If you can't avoid being hit, block the attack with Fiora W Riposte. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don't unleash your damage; wait for the invulnerability to end.

Kled.watch: When Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, watch out for the fourth basic attack’s maximum-health-based damage. If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, use Fiora Q Lunge to create distance before you’re pulled; if you can’t escape, time Fiora W Riposte for the pull.
Kled.build: Build armor first to prepare for the main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.
Kled.fight: Early on, take short trades by hitting a vital with Fiora P Duelist's Dance, then retreat with the movement speed you gain. If Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, create distance before he lands four attacks. Once both Kled E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down, close in again with Fiora Q Lunge.
Kled.laning: Don’t try to force a win against Kled’s early physical trades. Pull the wave toward your turret and stay in experience range, even if you miss a few minions. If you can’t reliably kill Kled after he dismounts Skaarl, create distance to limit his chances to build Courage. If you have the advantage, pressure him so he can’t farm minions comfortably.
Kled.combo: If the vital appears to Kled’s side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to hit it, then activate Fiora E Bladework after a basic attack to follow up with its first empowered attack, which slows, and its second empowered attack, which critically strikes. If the vital appears in front, hit it with a basic attack first and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. Use Fiora W Riposte to counter the moment Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope pulls you or applies an immobilizing effect.
Kled.escape: Before engaging, check whether only Kled E Jousting is down or whether Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is down too. Close the distance with Fiora Q Lunge when both movement abilities are down and you’ve dodged Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope’s pull or can block it with Fiora W Riposte.
Kled.phase: Early on, avoid Kled’s strong physical trades to limit your losses.
Kled.teamfight: Prioritize side-lane pressure and small skirmishes over large team fights. If you have to take a fight, watch for Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!’s long-range engage with vision from the flank, and use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to hit vitals and heal.

Malphite.watch: Malphite Q Seismic Shard steals movement speed, so don’t start a trade right after it hits you. Malphite E Ground Slam reduces attack speed, so engage after it’s used.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Magic resistance can’t block the physical damage from Malphite W Thunderclap. Use the maximum-health-based true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and R Grand Challenge against Malphite’s high armor.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then start trading to reduce his actual health. Once Malphite E Ground Slam is down, use Fiora Q Lunge to close in from the direction of the vital, then retreat with the movement speed you gain after hitting it. Look for another chance to engage while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down.
Malphite.laning: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, but don’t stay within range of Malphite Q Seismic Shard for long. If the current vital is hard to hit, don’t force your way in; wait for the next one.
Malphite.combo: If the vital appears to Malphite’s side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to close in from that direction, then follow up with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If the vital appears in front, handle it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. If a new vital appears after you activate Fiora E Bladework, hit it with the second empowered basic attack.
Malphite.escape: Don’t try to stop Malphite’s dash itself with Fiora W Riposte.
Malphite.phase: Afterward, use the true damage from vitals to pressure the side lane.
Malphite.teamfight: Prioritize side-lane pressure and small skirmishes over large team fights. If you have to join a fight, spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock up several of you at once. After Malphite uses his ultimate, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on him at the frontline to hit vitals and heal nearby allies.

Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, so move away from where the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so when health is low, block it with Fiora W Riposte or create distance. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, the slow from Fiora W Riposte has no effect, so back off until it ends and avoid being hit by basic attacks and Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Olaf.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. You cannot reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing with resistances, so build health as well. Lowering his attack speed can also help reduce damage that relies on basic attacks and attack speed.
Olaf.fight: Avoid extended fights early. Hit a vital once, then disengage with the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance. Olaf’s attack speed and healing become stronger as his health drops, so do not stay on him unless you judge that you can finish him.
Olaf.laning: Olaf is strong early, so focus on avoiding deaths. Stay in experience range even if you miss some minions, and pull the wave toward your turret. Move opposite the direction Olaf Q Undertow lands to make it harder for him to retrieve the axe and re-engage.
Olaf.combo: If the vital is on his side or behind him and you dodge Olaf Q Undertow, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. Use the first empowered basic attack from Fiora E Bladework to slow him, and aim the second at a vital if possible. If the vital is in front, hit it first with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge for chasing or disengaging.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so when he cannot retrieve Olaf Q Undertow's axe, you have a chance to close in with Fiora Q Lunge. Fiora W Riposte can block the damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so limit your losses and scale. He becomes relatively weaker as the game goes on, giving Fiora an advantage through side lane pressure.
Olaf.teamfight: Prioritize side lane pressure and small skirmishes over large team fights. If you have to team fight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.

Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, it is easy to also get hit by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and a basic attack, so keep your distance in front of him and save Fiora W Riposte. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, so trade only once or twice before backing off. While Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is available, don’t enter its range expecting help from allies.
Mordekaiser.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, Q Obliterate, and E Death's Grasp. Also consider armor because he deals basic attack damage, but avoid stacking health alone because he deals damage based on your maximum health. The healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible helps him sustain, so fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Mordekaiser.fight: Trade briefly by hitting a vital from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and using the movement speed to retreat. Do not stay on Mordekaiser for long after Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. Do not commit your damage just after Mordekaiser W Indestructible shields him; attack again after the shield is depleted or converted into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: Avoid forcing long duels early. Trade briefly by hitting an accessible vital, then back off. If the vital is behind or to the side of Mordekaiser and reaching it would put you at risk, wait for the next one. Keep your distance in front of him because of Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, and do not waste Fiora W Riposte in case he pulls you in.
Mordekaiser.combo: If you can reach a vital on his side or behind him, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. For a front vital, save Q and hit it with a basic attack and E, keeping Q for chasing or disengaging. Use E's first empowered basic attack to slow him and line up the second empowered attack on a new vital. Use Fiora W Riposte against Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp.
Mordekaiser.escape: After Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is on cooldown, you have a chance to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. Mordekaiser has no ability to create distance, so once you are on him, you can keep going for vitals. However, if Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is available, do not enter its range alone.
Mordekaiser.phase: The available information does not establish who has the early advantage, so focus on short trades as Fiora. Even then, a duel inside Mordekaiser R Realm of Death may be unfavorable, so do not blindly engage while his ultimate is available.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: If you have to team fight, spread out from your allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp does not pull you all in together. Fiora R Grand Challenge can also be used on the frontline; hitting all four vitals or killing the target can heal nearby allies.

Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither lowers both movement speed and attack speed, so do not fight for long while affected. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, his health and defensive power are substantial, so wait out its duration unless you have a clear advantage in numbers and firepower. Your armor is reduced while standing in Nasus E Spirit Fire, so move out of the area.
Nasus.build: Nasus's main damage source, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, deals physical damage, so build armor first. Armor does not mitigate the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire or Nasus R Fury of the Sands, and Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Nasus.fight: In short trades, proc a vital, then retreat using the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance, and engage again when another opportunity arises. Do not force a fight while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: If you push the wave under Nasus's turret, it becomes easier for him to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Let the wave come toward you and pressure Nasus when he comes out to last-hit; this can also create an opportunity to call for a gank.
Nasus.combo: If the vital appears on Nasus's side or behind him, engage toward that vital in this order: Fiora Q Lunge → basic attack → Fiora E Bladework. Use the first empowered basic attack from Fiora E Bladework to slow him, then hit the vital with the second empowered critical strike. If the vital is in front, hit it first with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge for chasing or disengaging.
Nasus.escape: After Nasus W Wither is on cooldown, Fiora Q Lunge is a good way to close the gap and engage. Nasus has no way to create distance on his own other than Flash, so chase him with the slow from Fiora E Bladework once you are on him. You can block an empowered attack from Nasus Q Siphoning Strike with Fiora W Riposte.
Nasus.phase: Nasus can become harder to deal with as the game goes on because of his permanent stacks, so it is important not to let him scale comfortably.
Nasus.teamfight: If you have to team fight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on a frontline target like Nasus to deal true damage based on maximum health. However, do not start a direct fight without a clear advantage while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.

Ornn.watch: Stand away from walls and the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to avoid being knocked up by Ornn E Searing Charge. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, do not move forward; keep your distance until the effect ends. Dodge the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God to the side, and also move out of the straight line along which Ornn can redirect it.
Ornn.build: The available information does not specify a particular item to buy first, so no specific first purchase can be recommended. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so avoid building resistance against only one type. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Ornn.fight: Trade briefly when you can hit a vital, then retreat using the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance. Do not go deep if you could be hit by Ornn E Searing Charge near a wall or the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture. After Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are on cooldown, close in with Fiora Q Lunge and use Fiora W Riposte to counter his return attack.
Ornn.laning: Ornn's damage is low early, so get ahead by repeating short trades around vitals. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, engage to interrupt him. If a vital appears on a side you cannot hit, do not force your way in; wait for the next vital.
Ornn.combo: If the vital appears on Ornn's side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to reach that side, land a basic attack, then follow with both empowered attacks from Fiora E Bladework. If the vital appears in front, use a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework first, saving Fiora Q Lunge for chasing or disengaging. If you block the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God with Fiora W Riposte, you can counter with a stun.
Ornn.phase: Early, get ahead by building up short trades against Ornn, whose damage is low. As the game goes on, Ornn gains items and upgrades his allies' items to Masterwork items, so use your early lead to keep up the pressure.
Ornn.teamfight: If you have to team fight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on Ornn in the frontline to aim for true damage based on maximum health. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies, but avoid the straight line between Ornn and the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
Ornn.escape: If only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, don't dive too deep, since Ornn can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge when both of his mobility abilities are down, or in particular before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up. Save Fiora W Riposte to block Ornn's crowd control and continue the chase.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so stay out of its range. If you read the engage, block it with Fiora W Riposte and reflect the stun. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, so wait for it to end or move around to the side. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. However, Pantheon R Grand Starfall has penetration, and Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking only armor or health. Pantheon has relatively high armor, so mix in penetration or use the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance.
Pantheon.fight: Avoid toe-to-toe trades early. Hit one vital, then use the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance to back away after a short trade. Fight where you can use Fiora W Riposte to catch Pantheon W Shield Vault and reflect the stun. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault comes out, stop attacking from the front and move to a side vital or wait for the ability to end.
Pantheon.laning: Focus on not giving up a kill early. Pull the wave toward your turret and collect experience, even if you have to give up some minions. Against Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke, keep minions between you and Pantheon to reduce the damage you take by standing behind the first target hit. Don’t start an extended trade within range of Pantheon W Shield Vault.
Pantheon.combo: If a vital appears on Pantheon’s side or back, use Fiora Q Lunge to move in that direction and hit the vital, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If the vital appears in front, hit it first with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge for chasing or disengaging. Activate Fiora E Bladework when you can stay close, then, if a new vital appears, hit it with the second critical basic attack.
Pantheon.escape: Look for an opening after Pantheon W Shield Vault is used, but time your engage before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again, since he can use it to escape. Close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge during that window, and respond to Pantheon’s stun attempt with Fiora W Riposte.
Pantheon.phase: From mid game, once you have some items, force 1v1s in the side lane.
Pantheon.teamfight: If you have to join a teamfight, target the high-armor frontline with Fiora R Grand Challenge to deal maximum-health-based true damage through vitals. Make use of the heal for nearby allies when you hit all four vitals or kill the target.

Poppy.fight: Early on, avoid forcing long fights. Hit one vital, then use the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance to back away after a short trade. Bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge first, then close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends. Save Fiora W Riposte if you have an angle to block the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Poppy.laning: Trade in open space, without a wall or narrow passage behind you. When the shield thrown by Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first to prevent Poppy from gaining a shield. If a vital appears on a side you can’t hit, don’t force your way in; wait for the next vital.
Poppy.combo: If a vital appears on Poppy’s side or back and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, trade in that direction with Fiora Q Lunge → basic attack → Fiora E Bladework. Slow Poppy with the first empowered basic attack from Fiora E Bladework, then line up its second, guaranteed critical basic attack on a new vital. If the vital appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge for chasing or disengaging.
Poppy.escape: Right after you bait out Poppy E Heroic Charge is a chance to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. However, if Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t dash in; wait for it to end. Use Fiora W Riposte when you need to block Poppy’s stun, then disengage after a short trade with the movement speed from hitting a vital.
Poppy.phase: Keep trades short early and don’t overcommit. When Poppy’s health decreases, Poppy W Steadfast Presence grants more sustained armor, so only go deep when you’re sure you can deal finishing damage.
Poppy.teamfight: If you have to join a teamfight, you can target a frontline champion like Poppy with Fiora R Grand Challenge. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone. Don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just to counter Poppy.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, dashing in with Fiora Q Lunge will be blocked and you won't be able to use movement abilities for a short time. Wait for it to end or approach on foot. Stay in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can't stun you against a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock's first hit lands, leave the remaining zone immediately. When Poppy R Keeper's Verdict is charging, move sideways out of its path.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of range to avoid the empowered basic attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind the minion line, and save Fiora W Riposte for when Quinn E Vault knocks you back.
Quinn.build: Prioritize armor items early against Quinn’s physical damage. The source material does not specify a particular first purchase.
Quinn.fight: Don’t force an approach alone while Quinn E Vault is available. After Quinn E Vault is used, close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge, hit a vital, then use the movement speed you gain to make a short trade and disengage.
Quinn.laning: Early on, accept the range disadvantage, preserve your health, and collect experience. Pull the wave toward your turret, even if you miss some minions, and farm while Quinn P Harrier is not marking you.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is used, if a vital appears on her side or back, use Fiora Q Lunge to reach it, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If the vital appears in front, hit it first with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge for chasing or disengaging.
Quinn.escape: Right after you bait out Quinn E Vault is your window to engage. Close in with Fiora Q Lunge and use Fiora W Riposte to catch Quinn’s counterattack.
Quinn.phase: Quinn has the advantage in the early lane because of her range, so Fiora should minimize losses and scale. From mid game, once she has some items, Fiora should force 1v1s in the side lane. In late game, aim to gain an advantage through side lane pressure instead of getting tied down in a large teamfight first.
Quinn.teamfight: Focus on side lane pressure instead of large teamfights. If you have to join one, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to aim for vital damage and healing. If Quinn comes in from the side, use Fiora W Riposte to block her attack and try to slow or stun her.

Renekton.watch: When Renekton’s Fury is above half or high enough to fill with one basic attack, keep your distance to avoid the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If you read the moment he’ll use it, block it with Fiora W Riposte and counterattack.
Renekton.build: Renekton’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. However, empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces armor, so focus on positioning to dodge that dash rather than only stacking more armor. If healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek lets him sustain through trades, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Renekton.fight: Trade briefly when Renekton has no Fury or right after he uses Q, W, and E. After hitting a vital with Fiora P Duelist's Dance, use the movement speed to back away before he can counterattack. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, you can close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge and counterattack.
Renekton.laning: Early on, don’t force a direct fight with Renekton. Pull the wave toward your turret while staying close enough to collect experience, even if you miss some minions. Don’t stand in or behind the minion wave, where Renekton E Slice and Dice can use minions as stepping stones.
Renekton.combo: If a vital appears on Renekton’s side or back, attack in that direction with Fiora Q Lunge → basic attack → Fiora E Bladework. If the vital appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge for chasing or disengaging. If you read Renekton W Ruthless Predator, block it with Fiora W Riposte and aim to counter with a stun.
Renekton.escape: Right after Renekton E Slice and Dice has been fully spent is a chance to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down, the risk of a counterattack is lower. If Renekton used E to disengage, close the gap and fight while he has no way out.
Renekton.teamfight: Fiora benefits more from side lane pressure than from large teamfights. If you have to join one, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline and hit the vitals. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.

Riven.fight: Take a short trade when Riven Q Broken Wings is used to clear minions. After hitting a vital, use the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance to retreat and avoid her counterattack. If Riven Q Broken Wings is not back up yet, look for a chance to close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge.
Riven.laning: Early on, don’t try to force a win against Riven’s strong physical trades. Stay in range to collect experience even if you miss a few minions, and let the wave come toward your turret. Look to trade back only at the moment she uses Riven Q Broken Wings on minions.
Riven.combo: If a vital appears on Riven’s side or behind her, use Fiora Q Lunge in that direction to hit it, then follow up with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If it appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or escape. Look for an angle to hit the vital with the second empowered basic attack from Fiora E Bladework.
Riven.escape: Both Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are mobility abilities, so don’t commit deeply just because one is down. In particular, look to engage with Fiora Q Lunge before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up. When Riven gets close and uses Riven W Ki Burst or the third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings, counter with Fiora W Riposte.
Riven.phase: Early on, play to limit losses and respect Riven’s physical damage in trades.
Riven.teamfight: Choose side lane pressure over large teamfights when possible. If you have to teamfight, you can cast Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.
Riven.build: Riven's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If she gets ahead, buy defensive items sooner and get some health to reduce the risk of being finished by Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings’ third dash knocks you up, and Riven W Ki Burst stuns you. You can stun her in return by using Fiora W Riposte just after she engages to block either effect. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her range and attack damage increase, so keep your distance until it ends, especially at low health.

Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are enemies on both sides of Sett, so don’t stand on the opposite side of Sett from your minions. Sett W Haymaker gets stronger right after he has taken a lot of damage, so create distance after trading and dodge sideways from the center of its indicator when he casts it. When Sett E Facebreaker is hard to avoid, block it with Fiora W Riposte and look for a stun.
Sett.build: Build armor first to withstand Sett’s basic attacks and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Lowering his attack speed can also reduce the damage from his basic attacks. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your maximum health, and resistance cannot reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so focus on dodging the center rather than stacking health alone.
Sett.fight: Save Fiora W Riposte until you can use it to block Sett E Facebreaker.
Sett.laning: Early on, don’t force trades against Sett’s strong physical damage. Stay in experience range even if you miss a few minions, and let the wave come toward your turret. After hitting a vital, retreat with the movement speed increase to limit your losses.
Sett.combo: If a vital appears on Sett’s side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to hit it, then basic attack and use Fiora E Bladework. Slow him with the first empowered basic attack from Fiora E Bladework, then hit the next vital with the second. If the vital appears in front, hit it first with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or escape.
Sett.escape: The window after Sett R The Show Stopper is down is a chance to engage. If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, close in with Fiora Q Lunge and go for a vital. If Sett E Facebreaker is still available, wait for a moment when you can block it with Fiora W Riposte.
Sett.teamfight: Pressure the side lane when possible instead of taking large teamfights. If you have to teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to aim for true damage based on maximum health. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.
Sett.phase: Focus on farming early while watching for Sett’s strong physical damage trades. Once you have some items in the mid game, Fiora should force 1v1s in the side lane.

Shen.watch: If you are taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you are likely to get hit by empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash or counter it with Fiora W Riposte to look for a stun. Also move out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault as his spirit blade returns.
Shen.build: Build tenacity first to counter the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t focus your resistances on just one type. Also avoid building a large amount of health alone.
Shen.fight: If a vital appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or escape. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, engage with Fiora Q Lunge, then use the movement speed after hitting a vital to briefly retreat.
Shen.laning: Use early trades to gain lane control, but focus on pushing the wave and keeping Shen occupied with CS rather than going for a kill. If Shen leaves with Shen R Stand United, take advantage of the empty lane and alert your team immediately.
Shen.combo: For a vital on Shen’s side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to close in, then attack in the order: basic attack → Fiora E Bladework. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, wait for it to end before continuing your basic attacks. Counter Shen E Shadow Dash with Fiora W Riposte to look for a stun.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is an opening to engage. If Shen R Stand United is also unavailable, close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge and use Fiora W Riposte to deter his counterattack.
Shen.phase: Early on, take advantage of Shen’s weak laning with short trades and lane control.
Shen.teamfight: Prioritize side lane pressure and small skirmishes over large teamfights. If you have to teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the frontline to aim for true damage based on the target’s maximum health. Hit all four vitals or kill the target to heal your allies.

Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter is dangerous while you are close, so take short trades and back off. If you are hit by the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, beware of the magic resistance reduction and the strong slow from the second harpoon; immediately use Fiora Q Lunge to create distance. Also watch out for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer.
Rumble.build: If you need a defensive item, choose one with magic resistance first. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building health alone.
Rumble.fight: If Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, hold your burst until the shield disappears, and engage after its movement speed increase ends as well.
Rumble.laning: Draw Rumble forward, check the direction of the vital, then take a short trade. If the vital is in a difficult position to hit, don’t force your way in; wait for the next one. Don’t stay and continue trading where the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hit you.
Rumble.combo: If a vital is on Rumble’s side or behind him, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, then follow up with a basic attack and both empowered basic attacks from Fiora E Bladework. If it appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or escape. Activate Fiora E Bladework when you can stay close, and if a new vital appears, hit it as well with the second empowered basic attack.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, but the movement speed increase from Rumble W Scrap Shield and the slow from Rumble E Electro Harpoon can hinder your engage. After Rumble W Scrap Shield is used, engage with Fiora Q Lunge once the shield is gone and you have dodged Rumble E Electro Harpoon. While chasing, you can keep Rumble close with the slow from Fiora W Riposte.
Rumble.phase: Early on, choose short trades around vitals over forcing long fights. The information provided is not enough to determine which of the two champions is stronger at each point in the game.
Rumble.teamfight: Prioritize side lane pressure and small skirmishes over large teamfights. If you have to teamfight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to aim for true damage based on maximum health. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.

Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash becomes more dangerous the longer it charges because of its knockup and stun, so use Fiora Q Lunge to sidestep. If you cannot dodge it, use Fiora W Riposte to block the immobilizing effects and aim for a stun. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught charges in a straight line, so sidestep instead of running forward or backward.
Sion.build: Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion W Soul Furnace and Sion E Roar of the Slayer deal magic damage, and Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces armor, so avoid being hit by it. Avoid building only large amounts of health, since Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your maximum health.
Sion.fight: Trade briefly toward a vital, then retreat using the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, look for a chance to focus damage and break its shield before it explodes. If you dodged Sion Q Decimating Smash or Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is on cooldown, close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge.
Sion.laning: Early on, repeat trades where you hit one vital and retreat instead of taking an extended fight. Sion gains maximum health by killing units, so push the lane to disrupt his farming or use that time to gain an advantage in another lane. After killing Sion, move away from where Sion P Glory in Death will revive him.
Sion.combo: If a vital appears on Sion's side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to close in from that direction and land a basic attack, then activate Fiora E Bladework when you can stay close. If the vital appears in front, take it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. If you cannot avoid the immobilizing effects from Sion Q Decimating Smash where you are, block them with Fiora W Riposte and aim for a stun.
Sion.escape: If Sion Q Decimating Smash is also on cooldown, look for a vital while the risk of being hit by crowd control is lower. If Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is still available, avoid facing him head-on in narrow passages or paths alongside walls.
Sion.phase: Early on, Fiora should avoid overcommitting and take vitals with short trades.
Sion.teamfight: When possible, choose side-lane pressure and skirmishes over large teamfights. If you have to take a teamfight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on Sion, the frontline, and attack him with its maximum-health-based true damage. Make use of the healing with your allies when you hit all four vitals or kill the target.

Singed.watch: Following Singed Q Poison Trail means continually walking through poison, so do not chase even if he looks low on health unless you have enough damage to finish him for sure. You cannot use Fiora Q Lunge on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so go around that area. Check behind Singed so Singed E Fling does not throw you toward the enemy team, and time Fiora W Riposte to block E Fling.
Singed.build: Secure movement speed first so you can get out of Singed Q Poison Trail. Build magic resistance, not armor, to resist Singed's damage. Singed E Fling deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only large amounts of health.
Singed.fight: Use the movement speed from hitting a vital to get out of Singed Q Poison Trail, and do not chase unless you have a sure way to finish him. Approach along a path without Singed W Mega Adhesive, and block Singed E Fling with Fiora W Riposte.
Singed.laning: After hitting one vital, use the movement speed to create distance, and do not prolong the trade while standing in Singed Q Poison Trail. Singed becomes difficult to kill once he has his core items, so do not miss your chance to pressure him early.
Singed.combo: If a vital appears on Singed's side or behind him, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If the vital appears in front, take it first with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. Activate Fiora E Bladework when you can land both empowered attacks, and aim the second attack at a new vital.
Singed.escape: Singed has no skill that creates distance on its own, so use Fiora Q Lunge to close in when you have an opening.
