You cannot use Fiora Q Lunge on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so go around the adhesive before engaging. An opening to fight close is when you can block Singed E Fling with Fiora W Riposte.
Singed.teamfight: When possible, avoid large teamfights and apply pressure in a side lane. If a teamfight breaks out, do not chase Singed to the end; keep him occupied with Fiora W Riposte while attacking his allies. If you have to fight the frontline, you can break it down with the maximum-health-based true damage from Fiora R Grand Challenge.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact stuns on wall impact and its cooldown is greatly reduced. If you are already suppressed by Skarner R Impale, you cannot escape with Fiora Q Lunge.
Skarner.fight: Bait out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, then close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge. Hit a vital, take a short trade, then retreat using the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance. Avoid extended fights where you keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Skarner.laning: Trade in open space, since you can be stunned by Skarner E Ixtal's Impact when you are backed against a wall. Approach only vitals you can hit, then retreat using the movement speed after hitting one. Do not overcommit early; look for a trade that baits out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact first.
Skarner.combo: If a vital appears on Skarner's side or behind him, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If the vital appears in front, take it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. If you can stay close, hit a new vital with the second empowered basic attack from Fiora E Bladework.
Skarner.escape: Immediately after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact has been spent is an opening to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. Continue the trade if you can time Fiora W Riposte to block the crowd control from Skarner E Ixtal's Impact or Skarner R Impale. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact pushes you into a wall and stuns you, retreat while accounting for his next charge as well.
Skarner.phase: Early on, it is important to delay Skarner's item timings, and Fiora should also choose short trades over overcommitting. Even late, look for an advantage with split push rather than large teamfights, but keep in mind that Skarner's damage and durability grow as he stacks tank items.
Skarner.teamfight: When possible, Fiora should pressure a side lane and avoid large teamfights. If you have to take a teamfight, you can target a durable frontline like Skarner with Fiora R Grand Challenge. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies, and be especially careful about your position near the edge of an objective pit where Skarner R Impale could pull you away.
Skarner.build: First decide whether you need a way to remove the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If so, build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar. If you build resistances, consider magic resistance first against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Magic resistance won’t block the physical damage from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval or Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact.

TahmKench.watch: If Tahm Kench has two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks on you, back off and wait for them to expire. If you see the stun from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash or the knockup from Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive coming, block it with Fiora W Riposte and counterattack. Tahm Kench E Thick Skin’s shield and healing make him hard to finish off with small bits of damage alone.
TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against the main damage from Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If his healing prolongs the duel, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items. Counter high armor with penetration or the true damage from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance.
TahmKench.fight: When you have no Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks, hit a vital and use the movement speed to create distance. If Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down and you have an opening to commit, close in with Fiora Q Lunge and look for consecutive vitals. Save Fiora W Riposte until you can block Tahm Kench’s stun or knockup.
TahmKench.laning: Early on, avoid overcommitting. Make trades by striking one vital and backing off. Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can turn some damage into a shield or healing, so don’t expect repeated small trades to steadily wear him down. If you have two Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks, stop trading and back away.
TahmKench.combo: If a vital appears on his side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to approach from that direction, land a basic attack, then use Fiora E Bladework. Stay on him with the slow from the first empowered attack, then land the guaranteed critical strike from the second attack on the vital. If the vital is in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework first, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage.
TahmKench.escape: Once Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, you have a good window to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. If you blocked Tahm Kench’s stun or knockup with Fiora W Riposte, counterattack and keep targeting vitals. When you use Fiora Q Lunge to engage, hit the enemy so you can move again sooner.
TahmKench.teamfight: Whenever possible, choose side lane pressure and small skirmishes over large teamfights. If you have to teamfight, you can target a high-armor frontline champion like Tahm Kench with Fiora R Grand Challenge to deal true damage based on maximum health and provide healing. Account for the possibility that Tahm Kench R Devour can protect the enemy your team is trying to finish. If an ally is swallowed, focus your damage on Tahm Kench.
TahmKench.phase: Early on, Fiora trades without overcommitting and manages Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks. The available information alone isn’t enough to determine which champion has the advantage in the mid or late game.

Trundle.watch: Right after Trundle Q Chomp hits you, your attack damage is reduced, so stop trading and reengage once the effect ends. Trundle W Frozen Domain increases his attack speed and healing, so step out and wait for its duration to expire. Trundle E Pillar of Ice can block your escape through narrow paths, so fight in open areas. Keep your distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active.
Trundle.build: If healing from Trundle P King’s Tribute and Trundle W Frozen Domain offsets your vital damage, buy Executioner’s Calling between your core items. Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate reduces your resistances and deals magic damage, so prioritize getting out of its range over stacking more resistance.
Trundle.fight: Hit one of the vitals revealed by Fiora P Duelist’s Dance, then use the movement speed to briefly disengage. Reengage after the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp and the duration of Trundle W Frozen Domain have ended. If you expect the forced movement from Trundle E Pillar of Ice, save Fiora W Riposte and time it to block the effect.
Trundle.laning: Trundle P King’s Tribute heals him whenever a nearby enemy unit dies, so avoid extended poke fights in front of a large wave. After hitting a vital and lowering his health, secure the advantage immediately or push the lane to force him to recall. Early on, Fiora should avoid overcommitting and stick to short trades.
Trundle.combo: If a vital appears on his side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to approach from that direction and hit it, then follow a basic attack with two empowered attacks from Fiora E Bladework. Handle a front-facing vital with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. When you can stay on him, activate Fiora E Bladework to slow him with the first attack, then land the guaranteed critical strike from the second attack on the next vital.
Trundle.escape: Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Fiora Q Lunge when Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and he has left Trundle W Frozen Domain. You can fight more favorably once the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp has ended. Save Fiora W Riposte to block the forced movement from Trundle E Pillar of Ice.
Trundle.phase: Even in the late game, avoid solo fights while Trundle R Subjugate is active and look for a chance to engage after it ends.
Trundle.teamfight: Fiora is stronger in side lane pressure and small skirmishes than in large teamfights. If you have to teamfight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the frontline to break it down with true damage based on maximum health. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.

Tryndamere.watch: Watch out for the critical strikes from Tryndamere P Battle Fury and the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. If he builds Fury by hitting minions, create distance before he can engage. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, let it run out instead of dumping your damage into him. When retreating while avoiding Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, walk backward while facing Tryndamere.
Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust lets him sustain through the duel, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Tryndamere.fight: Early on, avoid extended basic attack fights. Make short trades by hitting one vital and using the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance to back away. Bait out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, then close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge and use the slow from Fiora W Riposte to create an opportunity to chase. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance and attack again once it ends.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, poke Tryndamere to keep him from building Fury with last hits, but if physical damage trades are unfavorable, let the wave push toward your turret. Stay close enough to gain experience even if you miss a few minions, and create distance as soon as Tryndamere starts building Fury.
Tryndamere.combo: If a vital appears on Tryndamere’s side or behind him, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If the vital is in front, handle it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. Slow him with the first attack of Fiora E Bladework and line up the second critical strike on the next vital.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, you have an opportunity to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, don’t immediately start a basic attack fight. When you need to avoid the slow, walk backward while facing Tryndamere. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop chasing and create distance.
Tryndamere.phase: Early on, avoid heavy physical damage trades with Tryndamere and focus on minimizing losses. In the late game, keep pressuring with Fiora’s split push, but don’t recklessly try to kill him alone while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Fiora can use Fiora R Grand Challenge in side lane pressure and small skirmishes rather than large teamfights. If you have to teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to hit vitals and heal your allies. In a side lane against Tryndamere while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is available, don’t try to stop him alone; trade for an objective or send more allies.

Udyr.watch: Right after Udyr activates Udyr E Blazing Stampede, watch out for the stun on his first attack. Fiora W Riposte can block it, but immobilizing effects do not work while Udyr E is Awakened, so wait for the Awakened effect to end before trying to stun him. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health, so don’t stay in range and take hits for too long.
Udyr.build: If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle restores his health between duels, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items. Consider armor first when building resistance, but keep in mind that armor cannot block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both types of damage.
Udyr.fight: Make short trades by hitting one vital and using the movement speed to back away. Right after you bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, keep hitting vitals and don’t give him a chance to heal.
Udyr.laning: Udyr starts in the jungle and shows up for ganks, so place vision at key routes and jungle entrances. Don’t advance in lane while he is out of sight. If you fight him, pop one vital and back away. Use Fiora Q Lunge when you can hit the target.
Udyr.combo: If a vital appears on his side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to approach from that direction and hit it, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. Handle a front-facing vital with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. If you expect the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, block it with Fiora W Riposte, then hit the vital with the second empowered attack from Fiora E Bladework.
Udyr.escape: Right after you bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, you have an opportunity to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. If you blocked the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede with Fiora W Riposte, counterattack or disengage while that target cannot be stunned again. Immobilizing effects do not work while Udyr E is Awakened, so don’t rely on the stun from Fiora W Riposte to engage.
Udyr.phase: Early on, avoid overcommitting to extended fights and focus on short trades by hitting vitals.
Udyr.teamfight: Prioritize side lane pressure and small skirmishes over large teamfights. If you have to teamfight, you can target the frontline with Fiora R Grand Challenge once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle has been removed. If Udyr is too difficult to kill immediately because he has defensive items and a shield, deal with the weaker enemies behind him first, then fight with a numbers advantage.

Urgot.watch: Watch for Urgot E Disdain’s dash and stun. Use Fiora W Riposte to block the stun and look for a chance to strike back. Urgot Q Corrosive Charge slows you and marks you for Urgot W Purge, so decide as it comes in whether to dodge with Fiora Q Lunge. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of range before you reach its execution threshold.
Urgot.build: Build armor first because Urgot’s main damage is physical. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your max health, so think carefully before stacking health alone. Against Urgot’s high armor, add penetration or use the true damage from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge.
Urgot.fight: Staying near Urgot for too long lets his leg cannons’ damage stack up, so land a short trade on a vital, then use the movement speed boost to back off. Just after baiting Urgot E Disdain, close the gap with Fiora Q Lunge and continue the trade only if you have an angle to hit the next vital.
Urgot.laning: Don’t force a direct fight early. Stay close enough to gain experience, even if you have to miss some minions.
Urgot.combo: If a vital appears on Urgot’s side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to reach it, then follow with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework. If it appears in front, hit it with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. If Fiora W Riposte blocks the stun from Urgot E Disdain, use the stun on your counterattack to go for the next vital.
Urgot.escape: The moment after you bait Urgot E Disdain is your chance to engage with Fiora Q Lunge. When Urgot Q Corrosive Charge comes in, decide immediately whether to dodge with Fiora Q Lunge. If it has already hit and you can’t easily walk away, look for an opening to fight back.
Urgot.phase: Get through the early laning phase by avoiding Urgot’s heavy physical damage trades.
Urgot.teamfight: Avoid large teamfights when possible and apply pressure in a side lane. If you have to teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on a high-armor frontline target to deal true damage based on their max health. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.

Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, watch for the next tornado’s knockup. When Yasuo approaches, move sideways out of his line; if the tornado is hard to dodge, block it with Fiora W Riposte and aim for a stun. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the gap, so watch their positions too.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first to prepare for the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Keep in mind that armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield first with a light attack, then trade after the short-lived shield disappears. Just after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, approach a vital with Fiora Q Lunge. If you hit the vital, use the movement speed gained to back off and make a short trade.
Yasuo.laning: If early physical-damage trades are costly, stay within experience range even if you have to give up some minions, and let the wave come toward your turret. Keep the wave thin to reduce the number of minions Yasuo can use to dash in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: If a vital appears on Yasuo’s side or behind him, use Fiora Q Lunge to approach from that direction, land a basic attack, and activate Fiora E Bladework. Slow him with Fiora E Bladework’s first empowered basic attack, and, if possible, land the second, critical-strike attack on the vital. If the vital appears in front, save Fiora Q Lunge; handle it with basic attacks and Fiora E Bladework, then keep Fiora Q Lunge for chasing or disengaging.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, watch out for Yasuo’s physical-damage trades and minimize Fiora’s losses.
Yasuo.teamfight: When possible, look to gain an advantage through side-lane pressure rather than large teamfights. If you have to take a teamfight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to aim for max-health-based true damage. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target can also heal nearby allies.
Yasuo.escape: Look for an opening right after dodging the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest or blocking it with Fiora W Riposte. If Yasuo R Last Breath is also down, close the distance with Fiora Q Lunge before it comes back up, then use Fiora W Riposte to gain an advantage in the ensuing fight. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so don't assume he has no escape just because he has used it once.

Teemo.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand the magic damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap. When you need to pass through likely mushroom spots, use Oracle Lens to reveal and clear them.
Teemo.combo: If the vital appears on Teemo’s side or behind him and Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, use Fiora Q Lunge to reach it, then follow with a basic attack and an empowered attack from Fiora E Bladework. If you can hit a new vital with Fiora E Bladework’s second attack, you’ll deal a critical strike and vital damage together. If the vital is in front, hit it first with a basic attack and Fiora E Bladework, and save Fiora Q Lunge to chase or escape.
Teemo.escape: Engage during the window after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. If Teemo W Move Quick creates distance, don’t force a chase while he’s escaping with its effect; use Fiora Q Lunge when you have another opening to close in. Teemo has no listed immobilizing effect that Fiora W Riposte can block to stun him, so time Fiora W Riposte to block a key attack such as Teemo Q Blinding Dart.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Use Fiora Q Lunge to reach a vital, attack briefly, then use the movement speed from striking it to retreat. If you’re blinded, stop basic attacking and use Fiora Q Lunge or back away.
Teemo.laning: Teemo E Toxic Shot applies lingering poison damage even if you’re hit by just one basic attack, so stay out of range if you aren’t ready to engage. Check brush without vision with a Control Ward or go around it, then retaliate once Teemo appears.
Teemo.phase: Early on, avoid trades where you take Teemo’s ranged basic attacks and poison while backing away. If you give him too much time, he can cover a wide area with mushrooms, so watch your routes as you play.
Teemo.teamfight: If you have to join a teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to break them down with vital damage, and look for a chance to hit all four vitals or kill the target to heal nearby allies. When joining, use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap near objectives and in narrow paths.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so avoid being hit by it while Fiora E Bladework is active. The mushrooms from Teemo R Noxious Trap are stealthed and apply a slow, so expect them near objectives and in narrow paths. Don't pass close to brush without vision, where Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare can let him hide and gain attack speed.

Volibear.build: Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing can prolong a duel, so fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items. Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer.
Volibear.combo: Trade briefly with Fiora Q Lunge toward the vital, then a basic attack, then Fiora E Bladework. Slow him with Fiora E Bladework’s first empowered attack, and hit a vital with the second if possible. Use Fiora W Riposte to block Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun and counterattack.
Volibear.escape: Once both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer are down, use Fiora Q Lunge to close the gap. If Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun is still available, save Fiora W Riposte to use when he attacks. Look especially for the window before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back up.
Volibear.fight: Use short trades as your default: hit one vital, then retreat with the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance. Volibear can heal with W Frenzied Maul, so don't keep hitting Volibear whose health has decreased unless you have a clear chance to finish him. Dodge Volibear E Sky Splitter, then re-engage after Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks fall off.
Volibear.laning: Early on, don't force long fights; go for vitals you can safely hit. If a vital appears behind or to the side, use Fiora Q Lunge to get in. If it appears in front, save Q to chase or escape. If your health is low while Volibear R Stormbringer is available, fall back farther even if you are already under your turret.
Volibear.phase: Focus on short trades early and avoid forced duels. In the late game, pressure with split pushing rather than prioritizing large teamfights.
Volibear.teamfight: If you have to join a teamfight, use Fiora R Grand Challenge on a frontline target such as Volibear to attack vitals with max-health-based true damage. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target also heals nearby allies.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his approach speed and stuns with an empowered basic attack. Stay out of basic attack range to run out the effect, or use Fiora W Riposte as the stun comes in to block and reflect it. When the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter appears, move sideways to avoid its damage and slow. Avoid fighting while Volibear P The Relentless Storm is fully stacked.

Yone.build: The source does not specify a first purchase, so one cannot be identified. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so avoid building resistance to only one damage type. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about building only health.
Yone.combo: If a vital appears on Yone's side or behind him, hit it with Fiora Q Lunge, then follow up with an attack and Fiora E Bladework. If it appears in front, hit it with an attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. Look for an angle to hit a newly appearing vital with Fiora E Bladework's second empowered attack.
Yone.escape: Don't engage just because Yone Q Mortal Steel alone is down; also track Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed. In particular, close the distance with Fiora Q Lunge when his other mobility is down, before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up.
Yone.fight: Take short trades by hitting one vital, then back off using the movement speed from Fiora P Duelist's Dance. Don't engage first while Yone's Q tornado is ready. If Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, time Fiora W Riposte to block the knockup from Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed and try to stun him.
Yone.laning: After that, watch whether Yone keeps using Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions. If his Q tornado is ready, keep your distance until the stacks disappear.
Yone.phase: The source alone does not establish which champion has the advantage in the mid or late game.
Yone.teamfight: Look for side lane pressure and small skirmishes rather than large teamfights. If you have to teamfight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to deal vital damage and heal. Keep some distance from allies to limit the shield from Yone W Spirit Cleave, and don't stand alone at the very back of your formation, where Yone R Fate Sealed can catch you.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly hits minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel, watch for his knockup dash. While his Q tornado is ready, wait outside its range. Use Fiora W Riposte to block an unavoidable Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed and try to stun him.

Yorick.build: Build armor first to mitigate damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers. Armor does not mitigate damage from Yorick E Mourning Mist or Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles, which is based on your maximum health, so think carefully before stacking health. If healing from Yorick Q Last Rites lets him survive trades, slot Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Yorick.combo: If a vital appears to the side or behind Yorick, use Fiora Q Lunge to approach from that direction and hit it, then follow up with an attack and Fiora E Bladework. Handle a front vital with an attack and Fiora E Bladework, saving Fiora Q Lunge to chase or disengage. Slow him with the first attack from Fiora E Bladework, and if you can stay close, use the guaranteed critical strike from the second attack to target the next vital.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no mobility, so after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, look for a chance to close the distance with Fiora Q Lunge. If Yorick W Dark Procession is down, you can engage without worrying about being trapped by its wall. Use the slow from Fiora W Riposte to keep Yorick close, but save it if you may need it to block a key attack or crowd control effect.
Yorick.fight: Don't start a fight where many graves have accumulated; clear the Mist Walkers first. Dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist, then close in with Fiora Q Lunge, hit a vital, take a short trade, and back off with the movement speed from the vital. You can also look to engage when the Maiden of the Mist is alone in a side lane, away from Yorick himself.
Yorick.laning: Graves accumulate when enemies die near Yorick, so push the lane to make minions die under the enemy turret and prevent Yorick from clearing the wave on his side. If you dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist, step up to farm and look for short trades before it is ready again. You don't need to force a long fight early.
Yorick.phase: Play cautiously early, taking short trades while watching Yorick E Mourning Mist and where graves have accumulated. The source alone does not establish which champion has the advantage in the early, mid, or late game.
Yorick.teamfight: If you have to teamfight, you can use Fiora R Grand Challenge on the enemy frontline to target vitals and deal true damage based on maximum health. Hitting all four vitals or killing the target also heals nearby allies.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on your maximum health, so dodge its projectile. In fights involving Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles and the Maiden of the Mist, watch for the extra damage. If the Maiden starts attacking you, move away from Yorick himself. If trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, use Fiora Q Lunge to cross the wall or attack it to break it.
